name: cintexa-nexus-finance
description: CINTEXA Nexus — Financial Health, Forensic Audit & Corporate Survival Intelligence Engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cintexa/api" "npm run dev -w @cintexa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cintexa/shared && npm run build -w @cintexa/financial-engine && npm run build -w @cintexa/document-processor && npm run build -w @cintexa/ai-agents && npm run build -w @cintexa/api && npm run build -w @cintexa/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cintexa/financial-engine --if-present && npm run test -w @cintexa/document-processor --if-present && npm run test -w @cintexa/ai-agents --if-present
